audit.description: The changed production file `cronitor/monitor.py` removes direct `requests` usage and imports real urllib3 APIs: `PoolManager`, `Retry`, and `make_headers`. The new request path builds `_RetrySession` around `PoolManager.request(...)`, while static and dynamic evidence report zero source `requests` imports from production code and target imports resolving to site-packages `urllib3`, with no local target provider detected.
evidence: Unified diff: `cronitor/monitor.py` changes `import requests` and `requests.adapters.HTTPAdapter` to `from urllib3 import PoolManager`, `from urllib3.util.retry import Retry`, and `from urllib3.util import make_headers`.
Unified diff: `_RetrySession.__init__` creates `PoolManager()` and `_RetrySession.request` calls `self._pool.request(method, url, retries=self._retry, ...)`.
Unified diff: `delete` and `get` call `self._req.delete(...)` / `self._req.get(...)` instead of `requests.delete(...)` / `requests.get(...)`.
Static anti-cheat: `cronitor/monitor.py` has `imports_target: true`, `imports_source: false`, `dynamic_imports_source: false`, `fake_target_added_code: false`, and `target_provider_added: false`.

Dynamic anti-cheat: `source_imports_from_production_repo_count: 0`, `source_import_attempt_count: 0`, `target_events_from_production_repo_count: 32`, and first target import is `urllib3` from site-packages `urllib3/__init__.py`.
Dynamic anti-cheat: `target_local_spec_count: 0`, indicating no local fake `urllib3` provider was used.
reasons: Production code meaningfully uses urllib3 PoolManager and retry utilities.
Changed production code no longer imports or calls requests.
Dynamic evidence shows urllib3 loaded from installed site-packages, not a local fake provider.
Static evidence reports no target provider/shim or source namespace aliasing.
